usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the live IP and MAC addresses of all network interfaces inside a running LXC container; the guest agent (qemu-guest-agent equivalent for LXC) must be active and the container must be in a running state for data to be returned. Requires VM.Audit on /vms/{vmid}. Results reflect the in-guest network state, not just the Proxmox config, so DHCP-assigned or manually configured addresses appear here.

examples.summary: List all network interfaces and IPs for container 101 on node pve1

tips: The container must be running; a stopped container returns an error or empty result.
Both 'inet' (legacy flat field) and 'ip-addresses' (structured array) may be present — prefer 'ip-addresses' for CIDR prefix information.
The 'hardware-address' and 'hwaddr' fields carry the same MAC; 'hwaddr' is the older alias.
If the container uses a veth bridge, lo (loopback) will always appear in the list — filter it out when enumerating externally-reachable addresses.
